title: How to Make an ATS-Friendly Resume
description:
Why Your Resume Isn’t Getting Seen (And How to Fix It!) 

Over 75% of job seekers never hear back after applying—and the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) might be to blame! In this video, I’ll show you exactly how to format your resume so it gets past the ATS and into a recruiter’s hands.

What You’ll Learn:
 What an ATS is and how it works
 The biggest resume mistakes that get you rejected
 How to format an ATS-friendly resume
 The best keyword strategy to match job descriptions
 Final hacks to boost your interview chances
